label: GPT-6 Luna
output:
Rohan, fair question da. You and Divya trusted me with real money, so you deserve a straight answer—not a LinkedIn caption.

We let 6 of 14 people go last Friday. I gave everyone two months’ pay, and we’ve already helped four of them get interviews. It was the worst day of my life, comfortably beating failing maths in second sem.

The bridge round from the Hyderabad fund fell through on 28 October, even though the term sheet was basically ready. The partner said “we love the energy” and then went quiet for 11 days. So: noted, energy is apparently not legal tender.

We’ve got about five months of runway after the cuts. The app has around 41k monthly users; plumbers and electricians are growing, but AC servicing is losing money. We’re planning to shut that side and focus on housing society tie-ups. Three societies in HSR have signed pilots. I think we have a real shot there—but it’s a shot, not a guarantee.

On your 3 lakh: it’s still the same investment, on the same terms as everyone else in the friends round. The money isn’t gone, but it is at risk. I can’t honestly tell you it’s safe, and I don’t want to pretend otherwise. I also don’t think you need to panic tonight, but you and Divya should have the facts and decide what you’re comfortable with.

Can I call you both properly this week and walk you through the numbers? No spin, and I’ll answer whatever you want to ask. You have every right to ask.

And yes, I’m fine. Mostly. The security uncle now asks whether I want my 11pm office Maggi masala or plain, so at least one person has a reliable forecast. Amma also asked if TCS is still hiring, which was a very subtle vote of confidence.

I’ll be there Saturday. Pranav’s buying, so the company’s runway may be five months but my dosa runway is excellent.
